content: लघिमन् {%m.%} [लघोर्भावः इमनिच् डिच्च] .²1 Lightness, absence of weight. .²2 Littleness, smallness, insignificance. .²3 Lightness, levity, lowness or meanness of spirit; मानुषतासुलभो लघिमा प्रश्नकर्मणि मां नियोजयति <ls>K.</ls> .²4 Thoughtlessness, frivolity. .²5 The supernatural power of assuming excessive lightness at will, one of the eight {%Siddhis%} <ab>q. v.</ab>
